items.markdown:
![Chicken Khao Soi (Thai Coconut Curry Noodle Soup) - The Woks ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280322-1672-0139-0000-4fde016fc3cf:6)
Khao soi is `a rich and creamy Northern Thai curry noodle soup` . It features soft, yellow egg noodles and tender meat (usually chicken or beef) simmered in a spiced coconut milk broth. The dish is famously topped with deep-fried crispy egg noodles for a distinct crunch and is served with fresh condiments like lime, shallots, and pickled mustard greens.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/)[[2]](https://thaileefoods.com/new/khao-soi-thai-noodles/)[[3]](https://thewoksoflife.com/chicken-khao-soi/)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/ChefKenHom/posts/khao-soi-or-khao-soy-is-a-wonderful-addicting-savoury-dish-of-noodles-from-north/1255301149495048/)

History and Origins

Believed to have originated in the Chiang Mai region, khao soi has deep historical ties to Chinese Muslim traders from the Yunnan province who traveled through Myanmar. Because of this Chinese-Muslim heritage, it is traditionally made with chicken or beef rather than pork. The dish is also closely related to the Burmese coconut noodle soup known as *ohn no khao swè*.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/) [[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Khao_soi)

The Flavor Profile

Khao soi offers a beautiful balance of savory, sweet, mild, and tangy flavors. The rich broth is typically made with ingredients like:[[1]](https://www.thaicookingkohtao.com/recipe/khao-soi)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/LWD8V79dC6c)

- **Curry Paste:** A fragrant blend of shallots, garlic, ginger, turmeric, and dried chilies.
- **Spices:** Often includes curry powder and cardamom.
- **Coconut Milk:** Adds a velvety, creamy richness that softens the heat of the spices.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kao-soi/) [[1]](https://www.feastingathome.com/thai-coconut-noodle-soup-khao-soi/)[[2]](https://houseofasia.pl/en/przepisy/zupa-tajska/)

How to Eat It Khao soi is typically eaten using both chopsticks (to handle the noodles) and a spoon (for the rich broth). It is almost always accompanied by small side dishes so diners can customize the flavor. Before eating, you should squeeze the fresh lime over the soup and mix in the pickled mustard greens and diced shallots to cut through the richness of the coconut milk.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OdD7NGk-LSo&t=424) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OdD7NGk-LSo&t=424)[[2]](https://www.thaicookingkohtao.com/recipe/khao-soi)For tips on how to prepare the curry paste from scratch and get the right seasoning and consistency:![Related video thumbnail](https://encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcTeJDBu-B7PMQAv5fEqRgDat6Ld9ToqFQbkPtxOS-qnbyd9URxO)
